id: title:Gilbert09:retry a 408 from the shared rest client

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Request Timeout (408) to transient error handling alongside 429 and 5xx, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds 408 to transient status codes, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: Tier assigned based on the explicit implementation of the status code change; systemic benefit and shared client dependency are not verified in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry behavior or the shared client configuration, so the tier cannot be assigned. The score depends on whether the shared client actually implements the 408 retry and whether the warehouse ingestion path relies on this shared client. The comments and tests alone do not establish systemic benefit.

observations.behavior: Adds 408 to the set of status codes treated as transient errors alongside 429 and 5xx, and adds a test case and comment update.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow warehouse ingestion connectors to automatically retry on 408 (Request Timeout) alongside existing 429 and 5xx handling, potentially improving reliability for warehouse data imports.
